description:
Hushfeed v0.63.0 has 98 patches for global TikTok 47.0.3 and 47.1.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically). It includes the changes developed in 0.62.0, which wasn't published separately.

Mute feed videos adds a movable sound button. Stay on the video in full screen keeps the viewer on the current video when it ends. Downloads gain progress, creator folders and source details, with recovery fixes for interrupted saves. Feed limits preserve profile grids and your own posts. Feature Gate Lab uses the installed TikTok build's gate list.

This release also fixes settings and budget recovery, unfinished exports and diagnostic redaction. Ghost mode guards story play reports and shows its local reporting state. Two-account viewer-list privacy is still unverified. See the changelog for the full list.

Validation: 2303 runtime tests passed and 454 patch tests passed locally. Both Android lint checks passed. All 98 patches applied to both supported APKs with resource and manifest checks. The attached release receipt identifies the exact source and bundle. The audit candidate was exercised on a physical Galaxy S22, including both themes and 200% text, and the original installation and preferences were restored.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer. Refresh the Hushfeed source to update. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a TikTok APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.
